name: text-scramble
title: Text Scramble
description: Text that scrambles into random characters, then decodes letter by letter. Runs on hover, when it scrolls into view, or on mount.

props.name: text
props.description: The final text. It is rendered on the server and is what screen readers hear.

props.name: trigger
props.description: hover runs on hover and focus of the closest link or button, view runs once when the text scrolls into view, mount runs right away.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds from fully scrambled to fully decoded.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to stay scrambled before decoding starts, for view and mount. Use rising delays to decode a row of stats in sequence.

a11y: Screen readers hear the final text once from a visually hidden copy; the scrambled layer is aria-hidden.
An invisible copy of the final text keeps the width fixed, so nothing around it shifts.
With reduced motion, the final text is shown and never scrambles.

ai.whenToUse: Stat numbers that decode as they scroll in, tech flavored headlines, and links that glitch on hover.
rules: Use charset digits for numbers and prices
Use trigger view with rising delay values for a row of stats
Keep the text short; long paragraphs are hard to read while scrambling

id.description: Teks yang teracak menjadi karakter acak, lalu terdekripsi huruf demi huruf. Berjalan saat hover, saat masuk layar, atau saat dimuat.

props.text: Teks akhir. Dirender di server dan inilah yang dibaca screen reader.
props.trigger: hover berjalan saat hover dan fokus pada link atau tombol terdekat, view berjalan sekali saat teks masuk layar, mount langsung berjalan.
props.duration: Milidetik dari teracak penuh sampai terbaca penuh.
props.delay: Milidetik teks tetap teracak sebelum dekripsi dimulai, untuk view dan mount. Pakai delay bertingkat agar deretan statistik terbuka berurutan.

a11y: Screen reader membaca teks akhir sekali dari salinan tersembunyi; lapisan acak memakai aria-hidden.
Salinan teks akhir yang tidak terlihat menjaga lebar tetap sehingga elemen di sekitarnya tidak bergeser.
Dengan reduced motion, teks akhir langsung tampil dan tidak pernah teracak.

ai.whenToUse: Angka statistik yang terdekripsi saat masuk layar, judul bernuansa teknologi, dan link yang berkedip acak saat hover.
rules: Pakai charset digits untuk angka dan harga
Pakai trigger view dengan delay bertingkat untuk deretan statistik
Pakai teks pendek; paragraf panjang sulit dibaca saat teracak
